messages:
Olivia: FYI — hailstorm just started over 19th St bridge, cars crawling. Saw a dozen scooters abandoned on the bike lane. Caltrain delays popping up on 511. Anyone en route to downtown?
Chris: I'm on the 24 bus heading north, windows rapping like drumsticks. ETA moved from 11:05 -> 11:40. :grimacing:
Devon: Ugh. Just ditched my scooter at Valencia & 16th and walking. If anyone's near, I have a small backpack with a Charger. Pics incoming.
Maya: I'm at Mission & 10th with a tarp and extra gloves. Starting a 'scooter relay' — hop on, I'll ferry people two blocks at a time to the bike-friendly detour. No charge, just pay it forward. :pray:
Jamal: I can take two people in my car from 12th & Mission, leaving in 10. DM me your ETA.
Alex: Heads up — office shuttle on reduced stops per the app: "Downtown stop skipped". Snagged the screenshot and put it in #help.
Sam: Huge thanks to Maya and Jamal. Also leaving a bin of emergency ponchos in the lobby (near the vending machine). :rain_cloud: :heart:
Olivia: oncall-bot reported: TRANSIT_DELAY — 'hail impact on surface transit; expect 20-40m delays' (link: https://511.org/alerts). Re-routing folks to BART might be faster if you can get to Civic Center.
Chris: Anyone have a BART buddy? I'm 2 blocks from 16th — willing to split an Uber.
Maya: I'll swing by 16th in 5min and pick one person for a quick hop to the BART entrance.
Devon: Thanks! Appreciate the community energy today. :raised_hands:
Alex: PSA: secure any loose backpacks on your scooters — hail peeled the water-resistant coating off mine. :sweat_smile:
Sam: If you need a temporary phone charger, the IT cart is parked upstairs by ops. Leave a sticky note with your name.
Olivia: Okay let’s do a quick headcount — who's still en route? Reply with emoji: :bike: if walking with scooter, :car: if carpooling, :train: if switching to BART, :umbrella: if you made it already.
Maya: :bike:
Chris: :train:
Jamal: :car:
Devon: :bike:
Sam: :umbrella:
Olivia: Perfect. If anyone's delayed more than 45m, ping me and we'll mark you as remote for the afternoon. Stay safe everyone.
